Operator Training Simulator LibraryStudent edition

Chemical Engineering Unit Operations OTS

Browser-based operator training simulators and digital twins of industrial process units. Each one has a live DCS console, safety system, field view, training exercises and teaching tabs on process, design, operability and safety.

13Full version
11Coming soon
28Planned
10Topics
Developed by Assoc. Prof. Dr. Apinan Soottitantawat Department of Chemical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, Chulalongkorn University
MTMomentum Transfer OperationsHTHeat Transfer OperationsMSMass Transfer OperationsHMSimultaneous Heat and Mass TransferRXReactorsPSPhase SeparationCPChemical ProcessesUTUtilities ProcessesPTParticle TechnologyPDProcess Dynamics and Control

Each simulator opens on its DCS console. Work through the training exercises, then read the teaching tabs beside the console. Units marked Full version also have the complete set of teaching tabs (design, operability, HAZID, HAZOP, LOPA and more), each with its own lecture deck. Units marked Coming soon already run, and their teaching tabs are being completed.

About the simulators

Each OTS is a single HTML file that runs in the browser with no installation. A dynamic process model drives the DCS console, alarms, interlocks and trends.

Status

Student edition. Last updated 5 November 2026. Units marked Coming soon already run; their full teaching set is being completed.
